spans.s:
m. (-पः)
A sovereign, a prince, a king.
E.
भू the earth, पा to cherish, aff. क.

m. (-तिः)
A king, a sovereign.
E.
भू the earth, and पति master.

m. (-दः)
A tree.
f. (-दी)
Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac).
E.
भू the earth, and पद foot, root.

m. (-धिः)
1 The equinoctial line.
2 The circumference of the earth.
E.
भू, and परिधि a circle.

m. (-लः)
A king, a sovereign.
E.
भू the earth, and पाल who cherishes.

f. (-त्त्री)
SĪTĀ, the wife of RĀMA.
E.
भू the earth, and पुत्त्री a daughter; being turned up out of the soil by a plough.
